part_A_input_shift.rows: training patients of each system (seeded sample of 300000 rows per system)
per_feature: standardized mean difference of observed values
part_A_input_shift.ranking: absolute standardized difference x the feature's importance share (mean |TreeSHAP| of the source model)

part_B_component_recalibration.rows: validation patients, eligible hours 1-72, of the TARGET system (model moved) and of the SOURCE system (reference)
part_B_component_recalibration.method: TreeSHAP contributions of the source model are summed per component and put on the calibrated logit scale (Platt slope x contribution). On each system's validation rows an unpenalised logistic regression y ~ intercept + sum_c beta_c * component_c is fitted. beta_c = 1 means the component carries the same evidence in that system as in training; beta_c > 1 means the model under-weights it there, < 1 over-weights it; the intercept captures a baseline risk change that no input explains.
part_B_component_recalibration.attribution: observed / expected on the target rows after correcting ONE component only (its contribution multiplied by its fitted beta, everything else unchanged), next to the uncorrected O/E and the O/E after the full correction; a component whose correction alone moves O/E most of the way to 1 is the main driver of the miscalibration

specification.registration: immutable local record; not public preregistration
